source: Existing approved Meshy masters and retextures, recolored locally to the superseding 2026-11-03 art direction; no new Meshy jobs.
method: Original animated upper garment, trouser and hand surfaces with source-material projection; independently attached source hood, shoulder ornaments, front apron, lower robe and shoes. Original skeleton, animations, item IDs and stats retained.
world3Footwear: World3 shoe geometry comes from tizian-3-master. Existing converso-piedi and fanale-piedi items select it. There is no world3 epic feet item; no fallback is relabeled world3.

palettes.1: Furnace ash-brown and soot, leather, copper, ivory stitchwork, amber glass
palettes.2: Lagoon deep petrol and verdigris, ivory linen, brass, amber glass
palettes.3: Charcoal and oxblood, bronze-brown leather, antique gold, ruby and amber glass

art.rarity: Internal green/blue/epic file keys select restrained matte / richer detailed / precious finishes, never rarity-border clothing colors. Existing source detail preserved; hue-mapped cloth and metals, adjusted roughness and metalness. ORM red limits existing breathing glow to glass highlights.
art.icons: Original fantasy item paintings generated with builtin ImageGen: three 6x3 sheets, empty unworn garments and isolated pieces, then packed for the existing 73-ID atlas. Same world/finish/slot shares an illustration across alternate-stat item IDs; six starter cells retain existing painted icons. No photographs or filtered model renders.
